verdict.rationale: Metronome supports exporting billing/usage data to a customer's own data warehouse (docs-10) and allows importing/exporting invoices and contracts via API with an open OpenAPI spec, giving some data portability. However, there is no evidence of a full-account export/data-portability feature (e.g., a one-click 'export all your data and leave' capability), no documented open-format bulk export of all account configuration, pricing, and history for migration purposes. Missing for 10: explicit full-account export tooling, documented data-portability/exit process, and independent confirmation of completeness of exported data.
